title: Core: AS2 nested class definitions
description: Test compilation of nested/inner class patterns in AS2: (1) class defined inside a function body, (2) class defined inside a with() block, (3) class defined inside a conditional block (if/else), (4) anonymous class expressions (var Cls = class{}). Note that AS2 does not truly support nested classes — document actual behavior (parse error or ignoring nesting). Verify the compiler does not crash.
